name: Integrated Plastics Machinery
old_description: Since 2002, we have represented the top equipment suppliers for the plastics industry, but it doesn't end there. We work with our customers from start to finish. From consultation and equipment recommendation, to purchasing, training, and even equipment maintenance and repair. We will do our very best to make sure you are set on a path to success, and with over 90 years of combined experience, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive and lasting solutions for the plastics industry.
about:
Integrated Plastics Machinery is based in Corona, California, and was founded in 2002. The company began as a representative for equipment suppliers to the plastics industry, leveraging the founders' combined decades of experience to offer a full range of services from equipment selection to ongoing support.

The firm provides end-to-end support for plastics processors, including technical consulting on part design, tooling, and material selection; factory-based training programs covering basic to advanced molding techniques; and a service department staffed by cross-trained technicians who handle preventive maintenance, inspections, and troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic/pneumatic systems. The company does not manufacture equipment itself but acts as a distributor and service partner for multiple supplier lines.

Its customer base consists of plastics manufacturers and molders seeking turn-key solutions for new production lines or existing equipment optimization. The company serves the broader plastics industry, though specific client names are not disclosed.

Integrated Plastics Machinery emphasizes its 90-plus years of combined industry experience and its commitment to guiding clients from concept through production, positioning itself as a single-source partner for equipment procurement, training, and long-term maintenance.

old_description: Integrity USA is a central US-based manufacturer of injector molds and CNC machining company backed by a global network. With the ISO 9001 certification, we ensure every project meets top-tier standards from prototypes to full-scale production.
about:
Integrity Tennessee operates from Pulaski, Tennessee, positioning itself as a central U.S. manufacturer of injection molds and CNC-machined components. The company serves customers across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, leveraging its geographic location to provide responsive tooling and machining services throughout North America.

The shop provides a full spectrum of mold-related services, including new mold construction, mold flow analysis and design, injection mold repair, and preventive maintenance programs. Its machining division delivers precision CNC milling and turning for complex parts, along with mold tooling, die making, and rapid prototyping. The company states it works with a broad range of metals, alloys, and plastics, supporting projects from prototype through full-scale production.

Integrity Tennessee targets global manufacturers requiring precision tooling and machined parts, offering a single-source model that covers design, manufacturing, and ongoing maintenance. Its customer base spans industries that rely on injection molding and high-accuracy machining, though specific sectors are not detailed in public materials.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification and a four-step process — connect, design, manufacture, maintain — as differentiators that reduce risk, save time, and guarantee quality. It promotes a “one partner” approach from initial concept to final part delivery, highlighting quick-turn prototyping and rapid repair services to minimize downtime.

name: Intek Plastics
old_description: Our ESG IMPACT framework guides how we operate, invest, and improve across our people, our communities, and our planet. This page outlines our goals, metrics, and progress with transparency and accountability.
about:
Intek Plastics operates from Eau Claire, Wisconsin. The company emerged from the combination of Five Star Plastics and 3D Printing Ally, unifying their capabilities under the Intek Plastics, LLC name.

The company provides full-spectrum plastic manufacturing, including precision injection molding, multi-material and co-extrusion, plastic prototyping via 3D printing and cast urethane molding, and in-house tooling. Secondary operations cover pad printing, laser marking, drilling, machining, protective coatings, assembly, and kitting, supported by inventory management and just-in-time delivery. The facility handles both low-volume prototype runs and high-volume extruded profiles.

Intek serves OEMs in fenestration, data centers, aerospace and defense, off-highway equipment, medical devices and dental, HVAC/R, consumer goods, and industrial markets. Customers rely on the company for components that meet strict regulatory and performance requirements.

Intek differentiates itself through its ESG IMPACT framework, which drives sustainability initiatives such as bioplastic composites and regrind programs. Quality systems earned ISO 9001:2015 Noteworthy Recognition in 2025, with customer quality ratings above 99%, DPPM below 1,000, and RMA rates well below industry benchmarks.

name: Intermountain Wind & Solar
old_description: Intermountain Wind & Solar specializes in residential solar installations throughout these states. They handle system design, permits, installation, and maintenance to ensure your home has a high-quality, cost-effective solar system.
about:
Intermountain Wind & Solar was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Centerville, Utah. The company serves the Intermountain West region, including Utah, Idaho, Wyoming, and Oregon, providing solar power solutions for homes, businesses, and government facilities.

The company designs and installs custom solar panel and battery backup systems, handling every step from system design and permitting to installation and ongoing maintenance. All electricians and installers are full-time employees rather than subcontractors. Intermountain Wind & Solar works with name-brand equipment such as Hyundai, Trina, and mSolar panels; Enphase and SolarEdge inverters; and Tesla Powerwall batteries. The firm also offers flexible financing options to reduce upfront costs. It reports thousands of installations completed across its service territory.

Customers include residential homeowners in cities like Salt Lake City, ranch owners in Wyoming, and commercial facilities in Boise, as well as government projects. The company tailors systems to withstand the region’s intense winds, heavy snow, and temperature swings.

Intermountain Wind & Solar says its differentiation comes from not outsourcing labor, bulk purchasing that enables low per-watt pricing, and deep local knowledge of state incentives and weather challenges. Its stated mission is to be the premiere provider of custom solar power solutions, guided by values including integrity, honesty, professionalism, accountability, hard work, and communication.

name: International Coil Inc
old_description: International Coil Inc. was founded in 1995 to provide manufactured products and services to customers needing cost effective and reliable transformers and coils. As our reputation grew, we moved into larger facilities in Brockton, MA.
about:
International Coil Inc was founded in 1995 in South Easton, Massachusetts, to supply manufactured transformers and coils to customers seeking cost‑effective, reliable magnetic components. The company began as a focused magnetics provider and later expanded into larger facilities in nearby Brockton before settling at its current mailing address in South Easton.

Today the firm designs and builds a range of power conversion products, including isolated and non‑isolated DC‑DC converters from 1 W to 150 W, AC‑DC power supplies, and custom transformers and inductors. In addition to its own magnetics line, International Coil has formed engineering alliances with partners such as ALFA, LLC for analog hardware and power conversion, Bartek Technologies for firmware and FPGA development, Avanti Design & Development for mechanical and thermal modeling, and rfLyncs for RF and antenna design covering Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRa, RFID, cellular and GPS. These partnerships extend the company’s capabilities into full‑system wireless hardware, regulatory compliance (FCC Part 15, CTIA, SAR), and design‑for‑manufacturing support.

The company serves customers in power electronics, wireless communications, and defense‑related programs, as evidenced by its ITAR registration. Typical engagements include custom magnetic designs for OEM power supplies, wireless module development for portable and wearable devices, and engineering support for products requiring UL certification and RoHS compliance.

International Coil emphasizes on‑time delivery, competitive pricing, and engineering expertise as its primary differentiators. The company states that it was started to provide cost‑effective, reliable transformers and coils, and it now promotes a combination of custom design capability, quality assurance under ISO 9001:2015, and responsive customer service.

name: Interstate Power Systems
old_description: Interstate Power Systems have been a leading distributor of both on- and off-highway engines and transmissions since 1957. We also provide extensive parts and service for vocational trucks and heavy equipment. And we’ve got all your power generation, marine, transport refrigeration and OEM needs covered.
about:
Founded in 1957 as Interstate – GM Diesel in Minneapolis, Minnesota, the company began as one of the first distributors for Detroit Diesel and Allison Transmission. Now operating as Interstate Power Systems, the business is headquartered in Gillette, Wyoming, and maintains a network of locations across twelve Midwestern and Western states.

The company distributes on-highway and off-highway engines and transmissions and provides a full range of support services. Its Gillette facility offers generator sales and service, contract maintenance, electrical load bank testing, electric motor and radiator repair, crane and construction equipment repair, and mining equipment assembly and disassembly. Technicians also handle transport refrigeration, light utility vehicles, and dielectric testing, with 24/7 emergency response available.

Interstate serves customers in oil and gas, mining, construction, industrial manufacturing, transportation, power generation, and marine sectors. Vocational truck fleets, heavy equipment operators, and mining operations rely on its OEM parts inventory and field service crews to minimize downtime.

The company emphasizes its experienced, OEM-trained technicians, extensive parts stock, and a connected network of Interstate Companies divisions that share technical expertise and resources. This structure allows coordinated, end-to-end support from the shop floor to remote job sites.
